title: SEC1: dead code in crypto2dev_hash
description:
In crypto2dev_hash(), the check 'if (devctx_ptr == NULL) return BAD_FUNC_ARG;' at line 886 is unreachable dead code.

Every case in the preceding switch either sets devctx_ptr to a non-NULL address (e.g., &info->hash.sha256->devCtx) or hits 'default: return CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE'. There is no code path that leaves devctx_ptr as NULL and falls through to line 886.

This dead check suggests the function was either copied from a template where the check was meaningful, or a future case was anticipated but never materialized. Either way, it adds false noise: a reader may wonder what scenario it guards against.

Fix: remove the dead NULL check. If a future case genuinely needs it, it should be added back with a comment explaining the scenario.

Affected line: crypto2dev_port.c:886-887.
